CVE-2021-3427.title: The Deluge Web-UI is vulnerable to XSS through a crafted torrent  ...
CVE-2021-3427.description: The Deluge Web-UI is vulnerable to XSS through a crafted torrent file. The the data from torrent files is not properly sanitised as it's interpreted directly as HTML. Someone who supplies the user with a malicious torrent file can execute arbitrary Javascript code in the context of the user's browser session.
